answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 14610 Country: India Title: Is correct after completing the Qur'aan, imidiatly starting a new recitation, by going back to Soorat al-Faatihah and reading it along with the first five verses of Soorat al-Baqarah only. Question: Is correct after completing the Qur'aan, imidiatly starting a new recitation, by going back to Soorat al-Faatihah and reading it along with the first five verses of Soorat al-Baqarah only. Answer ID: 14610 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1136/1136=M/1430) It is not necessary; rather it is mustahab just after completing the Quran to recite Surah Baqarah till the verse 5 and then recite the dua of Khatm-e-Quran . It is narrated in haidth that the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) was asked: ای الاعمال افضل؟ قال: الحال المرتحل الخ وفی کنز العمال شرحہ: الخاتم المفتح i.e. O Messenger of Allah! Which is the best of actions? He replied: One who completes and at the same time begins. Allamah Al-Suyuti writes in Al-Itqan with the reference of Al-Darami that whenever the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) recited Surah Al-Nas he used to recite it with the first 5 verses of Surah Baqarah and then recite the dua of Khatm-e-Quran . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
